mechanism.name: per-lane load widening (load-instruction-count reduction) in MatmulVecBF16
mechanism.form: remap each lane from 4-element k-chunks (one uvec2 load per row per iteration, stride 128) to 8-element k-chunks (one 16-byte load per row per iteration, stride 256), cutting total load instructions ~43 percent for k=896
